Our story

How we began.

It all began in the most ordinary place—the office, where two people crossed paths without knowing that their simple meeting would become the start of something beautiful. As time passed, conversations turned into friendship, and friendship slowly blossomed into love.

Our greatest blessing came when our daughter entered the world. She gave our love a deeper meaning, filled our days with joy and laughter, and transformed our story from one of two people into a family built on love.

From an unexpected meeting at work to a life filled with love, memories, and dreams, our journey has brought us to this beautiful moment. And now, we are ready to begin our next chapter—together, forever.

A kindly note

Two things to know before you RSVP.

Adults-only celebration No additional plus-ones

Can I bring a plus-one?

We kindly ask that you attend with the guest named on your invitation. Due to our limited venue capacity, we’re keeping our celebration intimate and are unable to accommodate additional plus-ones. We truly appreciate your understanding and hope you’ll still celebrate this special day with us.

Are children welcome?

We love your little ones, but we’ve chosen to have an intimate, adults-only celebration. We hope you understand that we’re unable to accommodate children at the wedding. We sincerely appreciate your understanding and support as we celebrate this special milestone.

RSVP

Will you join us?

Kindly respond by the first of November, 2026. One note per guest or family is perfect.

Thank you

Details

Good to know.

Getting there & parking

The ceremony is at St. John the Baptist in Taytay and the reception at Villa Ardin in Cainta — both in Rizal, roughly 30–60 minutes east of Metro Manila and about a 45-minute drive apart. Free parking is available at both the church and the venue. Please allow extra time for Rizal traffic.

Cocktail hour

Between the ceremony and reception, please enjoy the cocktail hour we’ve prepared. Each guest will receive a food stub to redeem for food and drinks while we take a few photos.

Gifts

Your presence is the gift. Should you wish to give more, a note toward our first home means the world.

With love

Your presence is our greatest gift.

Having you beside us on our day is everything we could hope for. Should you wish to share a little something more, a gift toward the home and life we're building together would mean the world — but it is never expected.
